strings.name: Jean-Philippe Vassal
strings.summary: Born in Casablanca, Vassal studied architecture in Bordeaux and worked in urban planning in Niger after graduating. In collaboration with Anne Lacaton, he combines economical use of materials with generous space, prioritizing existing buildings and residents’ lives. Through housing extensions and transformations of cultural facilities, they and their collaborators address environmental and social concerns. The pair shared the 2021 Pritzker Architecture Prize.

strings.timeline.t6.title: Co-founds practice
